agcRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Two Block II guidance computers.
Command Module entry programs
are not Lunar Module landing
programs.

rsoRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Crew safety is not Launch
Escape System only. The Range
Safety Officer sits outside
Mission Control.

spsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Service Propulsion sources
disagree on vacuum thrust.
There is no required thrust.

dpsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Descent Propulsion sources
disagree on thrust and throttle.
There is no required thrust.

lm5ConsumableRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Lunar Module descent oxygen
is a teaching figure.
There is no required pressure.

recoveryRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Splash is the flown Ground
Elapsed Time. Distance is from
the recovery ship, not the
target.

pngsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Primary Guidance, Navigation,
and Control is not Abort
Guidance. Landing radar is on
descent; rendezvous radar is
on ascent.

isolationRequirement.label:
«requirement»
There is no stage-to-stage
electrical power and no
propellant crossfeed.
